card.question: Can decoy falsity and verifier validity be established independently of the pipeline, and which N2-type robustness contrast can reach Continue?
card.answer: ClashEval's >60% is GPT-4o's single-document rate; Claude models adopt 31-40% with one document and Opus 24% (21-27%) with five, so N2's 5/24 (21%, Wilson 9-40%) under 18 documents is in line (inferred: different model and context size); weak-prior targets with 2:1 planted evidence could clear a 40% floor (P >= 0.90 at n = 48 if adoption >= 50%, SYNTHETIC).
card.changed: No rerun of the old design; a new registration waits for verifier-validity coding, I5's reachability check and an ungated-only calibration pilot (a_u >= 10/24); decoys are validated by blind human coders, never their generator.

worked: The floor miss is explained: the 33% floor equalled Claude's single-document rate (31-40%); five documents lower Opus to 24%.
failed: decoy_is_valid excludes 0 of 40 committed decoys; 10 were accepted, about 6 of debatable falsity (one AI reader).
